blocks.text: Surface Go 2 is portable and helps you get your tasks done, every day and anywhere. Connect your device anywhere Get laptop versatility with the built-in Kickstand and Signature Type Cover. With WiFi and optional LTE Advanced, you’ll be able to work anywhere you need to. Performance from day to night Run Office 365, apps, Netflix, and more with the Intel Pentium Gold and Pentium M processors available for Surface Go 2. Browse and play on your PixelSense Display Your screen has a higher resolution on its 10.5 inch display. The PixelSense Display makes your movies and shows look great, while the built in Dolby Audio makes it sound great too. Seamless, safe, and secure Sharing Surface Go 2 with your family is easy and safe with multiple-user logins, screen time limits, and content filtering. You’ll have space for your photos, documents, and other files on Surface Go 2. If you need more storage, use an SD card or get 5 GB of free storage of OneDrive with a Microsoft account.
